about.heroSubtitle: A platform for strategic dialogue, economic cooperation and transformative action across Africa.
about.whatWeAreText1: The Africa Economic Forum is a premier platform bringing together African and global leaders to shape the continent's economic future.
about.whatWeAreText2: We convene governments, investors, institutions, business leaders and thinkers to transform strategic dialogue into partnerships, investment and action.
about.missionSubtitle: To accelerate Africa's economic transformation through strategic connections, visionary leadership and practical action.
about.winWinText: We create opportunities for mutually beneficial partnerships between African and international stakeholders.
about.visionaryLeadershipText: We bring together leaders who can shape bold ideas and translate them into meaningful economic outcomes.
about.strategicConnectionsText: We connect governments, investors, institutions and businesses around strategic economic priorities.
about.narrativeElevationText: We contribute to a stronger global understanding of Africa's opportunities, capabilities and economic potential.
about.communityEmpowermentText: We support inclusive participation and create opportunities for communities and emerging leaders to contribute to Africa's transformation.
about.visionText: A prosperous, connected and globally influential Africa driven by African leadership, innovation and strategic cooperation.
about.coreValuesSubtitle: The principles guiding our work and our partnerships.
about.sovereigntyText: Respecting Africa's ability to define and advance its own economic priorities.
about.equityText: Promoting fair opportunities, inclusive participation and shared prosperity.
about.transformationalLeadershipText: Supporting leadership capable of driving meaningful and lasting economic transformation.
about.narrativeJusticeText: Promoting accurate, balanced and forward-looking narratives about Africa.
about.innovationText: Encouraging new ideas, technologies and approaches to Africa's economic challenges.
about.inclusionText: Ensuring that diverse voices, perspectives and communities have a place in Africa's economic future.
about.impactSubtitle: Building connections and opportunities that contribute to Africa's economic transformation.
about.organizingCommitteeSubtitle: The team coordinating the Africa Economic Forum.
about.founderSubtitle: The leadership behind the Africa Economic Forum.
about.founderBio: Leading the Africa Economic Forum with a vision to strengthen strategic cooperation, investment and economic transformation across Africa.
about.advisoryBoardSubtitle: Experienced leaders providing strategic guidance to the Forum.
about.executiveBoardSubtitle: The leadership team driving the Forum's strategy and execution.
about.scientificCommitteeSubtitle: Experts contributing knowledge, research and strategic perspectives.
about.joinMovementText: Become part of a growing community working to shape Africa's economic future.

africaPeaceForum.title: Africa Peace Forum
africaPeaceForum.sectoralLabel: A Sectoral Forum of the Africa Economic Forum
africaPeaceForum.description: Shaping Africa’s Peace, Security and Strategic Cooperation.
africaPeaceForum.overview: The Africa Peace Forum convenes leaders, governments, diplomats, security experts, investors and thinkers to address Africa’s peace and security challenges and advance the conditions for sustainable economic transformation.
objectives: Strengthen regional peace and security cooperation
Promote strategic dialogue between governments and institutions
Connect peace and security priorities with economic development
Build stronger foundations for sustainable investment

platform.title: The Platform
platform.description: A high-level platform connecting political leadership, institutions, business and capital around Africa’s peace, security and economic priorities.

items.title: Strategic Dialogue
items.description: High-level exchanges on Africa’s peace, security and geopolitical priorities.

items.title: Institutional Cooperation
items.description: Building stronger partnerships between governments, institutions and strategic stakeholders.

items.title: Economic Security
items.description: Connecting stability, security and economic transformation.

africaPeaceForum.fromDialogueToAction: Connecting political leadership, institutions, business and capital to build stronger foundations for peace, stability and prosperity across Africa.

africaAgricultureFoodForum.title: Africa Agriculture & Food Forum (AAFF)
africaAgricultureFoodForum.description: Transforming African agriculture from subsistence farming to a modern, productive, and sustainable system.
africaAgricultureFoodForum.overview: The Agriculture and Food Security Forum addresses the transformation of Africa’s agricultural systems, food value chains and investment opportunities required to build resilient and productive food economies.
objectives: Strengthen food security and resilient food systems
Mobilize investment into agricultural value chains
Promote technology and innovation in agriculture
africaAgricultureFoodForum.fromDialogueToAction: Connecting agricultural leaders, investors, technology providers and governments to transform Africa’s food systems and unlock scalable investment opportunities.
africaAgricultureFoodForum.joinForum: Join the Africa Agriculture & Food Forum
